summary: The AllowedList manages a collection of allowed locations based on the session and location type parameters. It includes functionality to retrieve locations allowed for a particular session and to verify if a specific ID is within the allowed list.
purpose: To handle and verify a list of allowed locations for sessions based on specified location types.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: Represents the code of the allowed location, or 'ALL' for unrestricted.

workflows.name: SessionAllowedLocations
steps: Initialize a list to store allowed locations.
Set the database procedure name to 'SessionAllowedLocations'.
Add 'LocType' and 'SessionID' as parameters to the database procedure.
Execute the procedure and fetch data using a SqlDataReader.
Loop through the data reader results.
If the ID from the database is -1, add a location with code 'ALL' and break.
Otherwise, add the location ID to the list.
Return the list of allowed locations.

workflows.name: CheckAllowedList
steps: Initialize a boolean return value as false.
Loop through each entry in the list of allowed locations.
If an entry code is 'ALL' or matches the ID, set return value to true and break.

business_rules: If ID is -1, it represents 'ALL' locations being allowed.
A location is allowed if its code matches the 'ID' or if the code is 'ALL'.
conditions: If an ID from the database equals -1, it signifies all locations are allowed and the list entry code is set to 'ALL'.
If a location's entry code matches 'ID', it is considered allowed.
system_behavior: Retrieve allowed locations based on session and location type.
Check if a particular ID is in the allowed list.
